note: AI 爬虫变更日志。kind=vendor：运营方官方文档的变化，由每日定时任务按 notes/changelog-template.md 的模版自动写入并发布（KiN 2026-11-04 同意符合模版的条目无需审核），必须有 source（官方页面）与 quote（官方原句）；kind=directory：我们自己的爬虫目录收录变化。

entries.en: Added crawlers from Mistral AI (all three of its agents), You.com, Yandex and Naver. We analyze robots.txt for each; none of them count toward the grade yet.
entries.zh: 新增 Mistral AI（三个爬虫）、You.com、Yandex、Naver 的爬虫。都做 robots.txt 分析，暂不计入评级。

entries.en: Added China search engines and Kimi: Huawei PetalBot, Sogou, 360, Shenma (Yisou) and Moonshot's three Kimi agents. Shown in their own group, not graded.
entries.zh: 新增国内搜索引擎与 Kimi：华为 PetalBot、搜狗、360、神马，以及月之暗面的三个 Kimi 爬虫。单独分组，不计评级。

entries.en: Directory launched with 22 crawlers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Apple, Perplexity, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, DuckDuckGo, Common Crawl, ByteDance and Baidu, each checked against the operator's documentation.
entries.zh: 爬虫目录上线，收录 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Apple、Perplexity、微软、Meta、亚马逊、DuckDuckGo、Common Crawl、字节跳动、百度共 22 个爬虫，逐条对照官方文档。
